metadata.qualification: x86_64 ELF lift, verified IR, model and CFG

activation: Use bin/revng for the relocated, independent runtime.
notes: Candidate overlay only; original CPG catalog and formal qualification unchanged.
usage.summary:
rev.ng x86_64 ELF lifting runtime profile

Run bin/revng -C PROJECT project init OWNED_ELF --no-initial-auto-analysis,
then project analyze parse-binary and project artifact lift -o lifted.bc.
The bounded acceptance also saves the model and disassemble fold PTML, verifies
the lifted bitcode with its paired LLVM 16.0.1 opt, and checks the input hash,
target, ABI, normalized symbol address and nontrivial control flow.

The source archive is exact revng ba8cdb0278084da07b2655f19d1e5f1ce2ebbbdf.
Overall GPLv2 and individual-file MIT declarations are retained. Matching QEMU
source and original component notices, plus source releases and upstream build
recipes for retained copyleft libraries are included under sources/runtime/share.
The original vendor binary provenance is locked; binaries were not rebuilt here.
Only ELF debug information was stripped. Optional IDA import, other target
architectures, UI/network services and recompilation are excluded. The 1.4GB
optional prototype database is omitted using upstream's supported no-database
path. Original Requires-Dist metadata is preserved; this is an explicit ELF CLI
subset, with click 8.2.1 and pycparser 2.22 overlays matching required constraints.
CPython 3.14.6 and LLVM 16.0.1 are bundled. Host Linux x86_64 glibc and libstdc++
are required; gcc/binutils are used only to make and inspect the owned fixture.
No general semantic equivalence, recompilation or source-build claim is made.

Actual import audit additionally retains 13 exact-version official Python wheels for undeclared runtime imports (aiohttp, CLI rendering and database/server imports). Their versions, licenses, URLs and SHA256 are preserved in profile/revng-python-import-completion.json. Network service behavior is not qualified; offline checks deny IP sockets. Target source is unchanged.
